questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Czech Republic?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter P and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Czech Republic article.

questions.proof: The capital and biggest city is Prague (Czech: Praha, pronounced [ˈpraha]).

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Czech Republic?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter A and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Czech Republic article.

questions.proof: Czechia has no sea; its neighbour countries are Germany, Austria, Slovakia, and Poland.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The others are Šumava National Park, Podyjí National Park, Bohemian _____.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter S and has 11 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Czech Republic article.

questions.proof: The others are Šumava National Park, Podyjí National Park, Bohemian Switzerland.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In February _____ the Communist party took over the country and for the next 41 years Czechoslovakia was a Socialist state with a rule of one (Communist) party.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the 40s of the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Czech Republic article.

questions.proof: In February 1948 the Communist party took over the country and for the next 41 years Czechoslovakia was a Socialist state with a rule of one (Communist) party.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Czechoslovakia became independent in _____ from Austro-Hungarian Empire.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the 10s of the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Czech Republic article.

questions.proof: Czechoslovakia became independent in 1918 from Austro-Hungarian Empire.
